'''Ujooku''' was a large [[Wampa/Legends|wampa]] that the [[Terror Brigade]] included among its warriors in its combat challenge called the [[Onslaught (Terror Brigade)|Onslaught]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].
